links.outcome: Success rate and detection time of data poisoning attacks on healthcare AI
links.effect: Attackers with 100-500 poisoned samples compromised healthcare AI regardless of dataset size, often over 60 percent success; detection estimated at 6 to 12 months or not at all.
links.quote: Our findings indicate that attackers with access to only 100-500 samples can compromise healthcare AI regardless of dataset size, often achieving over 60 percent success, with detection taking an estimated 6 to 12 months or sometimes not occurring at all.

unlisted_practices: mandatory adversarial robustness testing requirements in regulation
privacy-preserving security mechanisms enabling poisoning detection under HIPAA/GDPR
international coordination on AI security standards
shift toward interpretable models with verifiable safety guarantees for high-stakes decisions

screen.reason: Security threat analysis and simulation of data poisoning attacks across multiple healthcare AI architectures and clinical scenarios, followed by policy recommendations.
